text:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for payments-service chart@v2.3.0 -> staging (canary=10%). image: registry.redwood.ai/payments:2026-03-21-rc3
jamie: saw a lint failure in release-notes CI, but deploy-bot continued. any objections?
sara: I saw that, it's the changelog heading format. should be quick fix. ci-bot: release-notes-lint failed: header-format (expected H2 'Unreleased' -> got 'Unreleased Changes')
mike: unrelated bigger issue: helm values merge for staging picked the overlay from tenant-a instead of global. observed during canary smoke: payment-worker replicas=0 in canary pods
olga: who applied tenant overlay? that overlay contains maintenance toggles, should not be in staging promotion flow
jamie: hmm, deploy-bot applied values-hash c3f4 -> overlay order: base -> tenant-a -> staging-overrides. deploy-bot expected tenant overlays to be gated by release tag
sara: quick dump of helm --debug --dry-run showed values merge order mismatch. here's snippet:
```
# merged values excerpt
replicaCount: 0  # from tenant-a/maintenance
featureFlags:
  newRetry: true  # from tenant-a
```
jamie: we need decision: pause canary and fix order, or pin current canary to previous chart (v2.2.9) while we fix merge order and release notes lint
release-manager: timebox 30m to decide. staging traffic is low but QA is running against canary
mike: +1 to pin and continue a controlled rollback to v2.2.9 for staging only. don't touch prod. we can keep canary instances alive for investigation but not route traffic
olga: how do we pin? we can annotate the Release with `redwood.releases/pinned: v2.2.9` which deploy-bot respects as a manual override
jamie: deploy-bot, can you accept manual pin annotation? give instructions and I'll apply if you can't
deploy-bot: received pinned annotation workflow request. To pin chart for namespace staging run: `kubectl annotate helmrelease payments-service redwood.releases/pinned=v2.2.9 --overwrite -n staging` Deploy-bot will detect and stop automated promotion for that Release.
sara: I'll open a tiny PR to fix release-notes header and post a TODO in the release notes checklist. tag: @release-manager
release-manager: do that, also add an entry in the rollout notes: "staging pinned to v2.2.9 due to values-merge ordering with tenant overlays; fix will be followed by re-run and canary resumption"
mike: for transparency, add the failing values hash to the release note: values-hash-before:c3f4, expected-order: base->staging->tenant
jamie: applying annotation now in staging. running command:
```
kubectl annotate helmrelease payments-service redwood.releases/pinned=v2.2.9 --overwrite -n staging
```
jamie: deploy-bot acknowledged: pinned. automated canary promotion will pause for this Release.
olga: also adding a temporary admission webhook rule to prevent tenant overlays from being merged into non-tenant namespaces; will push in next 15m.
ci-bot: release-notes-lint check will auto re-run on PR update.
sara: PR is up: fix/release-notes-header-20260321, CI green locally. pinging @release-manager for merge.
release-manager: merging now, will wait 10m for CI. after merge run a dry deploy to staging without promotion to ensure merged values are correct, then schedule re-run of canary with pinned removed after ops signoff
mike: timeline OK. after ops verifies, we'll remove the annotation: `kubectl annotate helmrelease payments-service redwood.releases/pinned- -n staging` (note the trailing dash clears annotation) and then kick deploy-bot resume via `/deploy resume payments-service staging`
jamie: saving a short postmortem in release-notes/notes.md and will attach to this thread with link when done
olga: rolling back tenant overlay ingress change through the overlay pipeline too, to avoid recurrence.
deply-bot (typo): :eyes:  <-- (everyone laugh)
jamie: closing the thread when staging is green and ops approves. current status: pinned, PR merged pending CI, webhook patch queued
ci-bot: CI passed, merge completed at 5601112460
release-manager: ops please verify staging app behaviour (replicas>0, healthchecks ok). tag when done
mike: staging checks OK: payment-worker replicas=3, readiness probe passing. I’ll leave the canary pods for debugging for 20m then we remove them if no regression found
release-manager: ops signoff received at 5601112590. schedule: unpin at 5601112700 and resume canary then. leave release notes entry in changelog.
jamie: thanks all, follow-up: create a small infra ticket to make deploy-bot enforce overlay gating order. ticket: INFRA-1983
olga: noted, and I’ll include webhook tests. :thumbsup:
(END)
